### BoK Gate check (v3 — MCORCH Master Execution Protocol)

For each BoK suite in `docs/bok/<slug>/`, verify completeness:
```bash
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  if [ "$slug" = "security" ]; then
    required_sec=(00-deepsearch-blueprint 01-brd-security 02-srs-secure-spec 03-sdd-hardening-architecture 04-fmea-security)
    missing=()
    for doc in "${required_sec[@]}"; do
      [ -f "docs/bok/security/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
    done
    [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ security — BoK complete (ciso-4-artifact)" || echo "⚠️ security — missing: ${missing[*]}"
    continue
  fi
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete" || echo "⚠️ $slug — missing: ${missing[*]}"
done
```

If the user mentions working on a **new module / complex feature / integration / architectural change**:
- Check whether `docs/bok/<expected-slug>/` exists with all 9 docs.
- If missing: surface in the **ALERTAS** section as a critical block per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.

## Rules

- **TypeScript errors → report immediately.** If there are TS errors, list them under ALERTAS. Do not start implementing new features until errors are resolved (unless the user explicitly asks to proceed despite errors).
- **Unhealthy containers → report with triage.** Suggest the fix command if known (e.g., `docker compose restart mcorch-vector-engine` for chroma).
- **Uncommitted changes → describe, do not commit.** Only describe what exists in the working tree; committing is the user's call.
- **Keep the brief tight.** No padding. No repetition of CLAUDE.md architecture. The user already knows the architecture — they need the delta: what changed, what's broken, what's next.
- **Pending Actions priority order:** CRITICAL (before first client) > NON-CRITICAL > Phase Zeta > Core v3 > Epsilon v9.
- **Knowledge Mesh numbers:** use `GraphRAG State` section from HANDOFF.md as the source. Do not invent counts.

> 16	## 1. Architecture Overview

> 55	
> 56	### 1.1 Window state machine (invariante §3.1 do blueprint — MR-CRM-002)
> 57	
> 58	A conversa WhatsApp é uma máquina de estado dirigida por **um único campo server-authoritative**: `conversations.window_expires_at`.
> 59	
> 60	| Estado | Condição | Composer (FR-CRM-017) | Custo (FR-CRM-014) |
> 61	|---|---|---|---|
> 62	| **Aberta (verde)** | `now() < window_expires_at − 2h` | free-form habilitado, selo "grátis" + countdown | 0 mco (service message grátis — fonte primária Meta pricing, blueprint §3.1) |
> 63	| **Fechando (âmbar)** | `window_expires_at − 2h ≤ now() < window_expires_at` | free-form habilitado + aviso de fechamento | 0 mco |
> 64	| **Fechada (cinza)** | `now() ≥ window_expires_at` ou `window_expires_at IS NULL` | free-form **desabilitado**; seletor de template aprovado + classe de custo por categoria | UTILITY/MARKETING/AUTHENTICATION = pago (deduct atômico) |
> 65	
> 66	**Regras de autoridade (NFR-CRM-001/004 — OTD-CRM-003 RESOLVIDA):**
> 67	1. **Recompute só no inbound:** o `whatsapp-webhook` grava `window_expires_at = message.timestamp + interval '24 hours'` a cada mensagem inbound. Nenhum outro ator escreve esse campo (trigger-guard §7).
> 68	2. **Enforcement só no send:** a action `send` re-lê a linha e re-valida `now() < window_expires_at` **server-side** no momento do envio. O composer é conveniência de UX, **nunca a fronteira** (NFR-CRM-004).
> 69	3. **Countdown client-side é derivado**, nunca fonte: a UI conta regressivamente a partir do timestamp persistido; staleness máxima 60s garantida pelo transporte (§8 OTD-CRM-013).
> 70	
> 71	### 1.2 Clean-room boundary (OTD-CRM-014 — documentada aqui)
> 72	
> 73	O layout 3-painéis e o modelo conversation/message têm **referência conceitual** no Chatwoot (core MIT — blueprint §2.2) e no object model do Twenty (AGPL — **ideias sim, código jamais**, MR-CRM-005). Fronteira declarada: **nenhuma linha de código, schema SQL, ou asset foi copiada de nenhum dos dois repositórios** nesta sessão nem será nas fatias de código; o modelo de dados do §7 deriva dos moldes internos do próprio repo (`lead_events` para FK composta tenant-escopada e append-only; `whatsapp_leads` para lifecycle). Qualquer port futuro de código exige fetch dos LICENSE + registro explícito (BR-CRM-007 · FM-CRM-04).

> 42	  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
> 43	  if (req.method !== "POST") return json({ error: "method_not_allowed" }, 405);
> 44	
> 45	  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
> 46	  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ")) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
> 47	
> 48	  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!;
> 49	  const serviceKey = (Deno.env.get("SB_SECRET_KEY") ?? Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"))!;
> 50	  const anonKey = (Deno.env.get("SB_PUBLISHABLE_KEY") ?? Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY"))!;
> 51	
> 52	  const userClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, anonKey, { global: { headers: { Authorization: authHeader } } });
> 53	  const { data: { user }, error: uErr } = await userClient.auth.getUser();
> 54	  if (uErr || !user) return json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
> 55	
> 56	  const admin: SupabaseClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
> 57	  const { data: cfg } = await admin
> 58	    .from("decrypted_meta_config")
> 59	    .select("long_lived_token, whatsapp_waba_id, whatsapp_phone_number_id")
> 60	    .eq("user_id", user.id)
> 61	    .maybeSingle();
> 62	
> 63	  const token = cfg?.long_lived_token as string | undefined;
> 64	  const wabaId = cfg?.whatsapp_waba_id as string | undefined;
> 65	  const phoneId = cfg?.whatsapp_phone_number_id as string | undefined;
> 66	  if (!token || !wabaId) {
> 67	    return json({ error: "whatsapp_not_configured", action: "Configure o WhatsApp em Settings → Meta (token + WABA id)." }, 402);
> 68	  }
> 69	
> 70	  let body: Body;
> 71	  try { body = await req.json(); } catch { body = {}; }
> 72	  const action = body.action ?? "list";
> 73	
> 74	  const authFetch = (url: string, init?: RequestInit) =>
> 75	    fetch(url, { ...init, headers: { ...(init?.headers ?? {}), Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
> 76	
> 77	  const pulse = (status: string, event: string) =>
> 78	    admin.from("infra_health_logs").insert({ service: "whatsapp-templates", status, event }).then(() => {}, () => {});
> 79	
> 80	  try {
> 81	    if (action === "list") {
> 82	      const r = await authFetch(`${G}/${wabaId}/message_templates?fields=name,status,category,language,components,quality_score&limit=200`);
> 83	      const j = await r.json();
> 84	      if (!r.ok) return json({ error: "list_failed", detail: j?.error?.message ?? null }, 502);
> 85	      return json({ ok: true, templates: j.data ?? [] });
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    if (action === "create") {
> 89	      const name = (body.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
> 90	      const bodyText = (body.body_text ?? "").trim();
> 91	      const language = (body.language ?? "pt_BR").trim();
> 92	      const category = (body.category ?? "MARKETING").toUpperCase() as Category;
> 93	      // Meta rules: name = lowercase letters/digits/underscores; body required; valid category.
> 94	      if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{1,512}$/.test(name)) return json({ error: "invalid_name", action: "Use apenas letras minúsculas, números e underscores." }, 422);
> 95	      if (!bodyText) return json({ error: "missing_body", action: "O corpo da mensagem é obrigatório." }, 422);
> 96	      if (!CATEGORIES.includes(category)) return json({ error: "invalid_category", action: `Categoria deve ser: ${CATEGORIES.join(", ")}.` }, 422);
> 97	
> 98	      const components: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
> 99	      if (body.header_text?.trim()) components.push({ type: "HEADER", format: "TEXT", text: body.header_text.trim() });
> 100	      components.push({ type: "BODY", text: bodyText });
> 101	      if (body.footer_text?.trim()) components.push({ type: "FOOTER", text: body.footer_text.trim() });
> 102	
> 103	      const r = await authFetch(`${G}/${wabaId}/message_templates`, {
> 104	        method: "POST",
> 105	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
> 106	        body: JSON.stringify({ name, language, category, components }),
> 107	      });
> 108	      const j = await r.json();
> 109	      if (!r.ok) return json({ error: "create_failed", detail: j?.error?.error_user_msg ?? j?.error?.message ?? null }, 502);
> 110	      pulse("healthy", "template_created");
> 111	      return json({ ok: true, id: j.id, status: j.status ?? "PENDING", name });
> 112	    }
> 113	
> 114	    if (action === "delete") {
> 115	      const name = (body.template_name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
> 116	      if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{1,512}$/.test(name)) return json({ error: "invalid_name" }, 422);
> 117	      const r = await authFetch(`${G}/${wabaId}/message_templates?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { method: "DELETE" });
> 118	      const j = await r.json();
> 119	      if (!r.ok) return json({ error: "delete_failed", detail: j?.error?.message ?? null }, 502);
> 120	      pulse("healthy", "template_deleted");
> 121	      return json({ ok: true });
> 122	    }
> 123	
> 124	    if (action === "send") {
> 125	      // Send a WhatsApp message via the Cloud API. template = business-initiated (needs an APPROVED template);
> 126	      // text = free-form, only delivers inside the 24h customer-service window (Meta errors 131047/131026 otherwise).
> 127	      if (!phoneId) return json({ error: "whatsapp_not_configured", action: "Falta o Phone Number ID em Settings → Meta." }, 402);
> 128	      const to = String(body.to ?? "").replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""); // E.164 digits, never trust client formatting
> 129	      if (!/^[0-9]{8,15}$/.test(to)) return json({ error: "invalid_recipient", action: "Número no formato internacional (só dígitos com DDI)." }, 422);
> 130	
> 131	      const mode = body.type === "text" ? "text" : "template";
> 132	      let payload: Record<string, unknown>;
> 133	      if (mode === "text") {
> 134	        const text = (body.text ?? "").trim();
> 135	        if (!text) return json({ error: "missing_text" }, 422);
> 136	        payload = { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to, type: "text", text: { body: text } };
> 137	      } else {
> 138	        const tname = (body.template_name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
> 139	        const lang = (body.language ?? "pt_BR").trim();
> 140	        if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{1,512}$/.test(tname)) return json({ error: "missing_template", action: "Escolha um template aprovado." }, 422);
> 141	        const params = Array.isArray(body.params) ? body.params : [];
> 142	        const components = params.length
> 143	          ? [{ type: "body", parameters: params.map((p) => ({ type: "text", text: String(p) })) }]
> 144	          : undefined;
> 145	        payload = { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to, type: "template", template: { name: tname, language: { code: lang }, ...(components ? { components } : {}) } };
> 146	      }
> 147	
> 148	      const sr = await authFetch(`${G}/${phoneId}/messages`, {
> 149	        method: "POST",
> 150	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
> 151	        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
> 152	      });
> 153	      const sj = await sr.json();
> 154	      if (!sr.ok) {
> 155	        pulse("error", "send_failed");
> 156	        return json({ error: "send_failed", detail: sj?.error?.error_user_msg ?? sj?.error?.message ?? null, code: sj?.error?.code ?? null }, 502);
> 157	      }
> 158	      pulse("healthy", `send_${mode}`);
> 159	      return json({ ok: true, message_id: sj?.messages?.[0]?.id ?? null, to, mode });
> 160	    }
> 161	
> 162	    return json({ error: "unknown_action" }, 400);
> 163	  } catch (e) {
> 164	    console.error("[whatsapp-templates] error:", e instanceof Error ? e.message : e);
> 165	    return json({ error: "internal_error" }, 500);
> 166	  }
> 167	});

> 325	## 7. Retention & Archival Policy
> 326	
> 327	> **A regra de ouro do módulo:** conversas de cliente = **PII sob LGPD** (BR-CRM-004). O ciclo de vida é dominado pelo direito de eliminação do titular — não por TTL técnico.
> 328	
> 329	| Data | Retention Period | Archival Strategy | Deletion Trigger |
> 330	|------|-----------------|-------------------|-----------------|
> 331	| `conversations` | Indefinida enquanto o lead existir | `status='archived'` é o archival lógico (linha viva, fora da lista default) | **`erase_lead(p_lead_id)` estendido** → `DELETE leads` → CASCADE físico (FK composta) — zero-residue (OTD-CRM-010/FR-CRM-012) |
> 332	| `messages` | Indefinida (append-only) — histórico É o produto | Nenhum archival separado no MVP; paginação por `(conversation_id, created_at)` mantém a thread barata | Só via cascade do `erase_lead()` — sem DELETE client-side (NFR-CRM-003) |
> 333	| `whatsapp_leads` (espelho) | Indefinida (lifecycle WhatsApp segue lá) | — | Incluída na extensão do `erase_lead()` pelo `(user_id, phone_number)` do contato (zero-residue completo) |
> 334	| `mcorch_nodes` observation | Indefinida (GraphRAG) | Embedding com o nó; backfill via `scripts/backfill-embeddings.ts` | Erase LGPD do tenant (trilho existente) |
> 335	| `infra_health_logs` (`service='crm-inbox'`) | 90 dias | Sem archival | Cron purge existente |
> 336	
> 337	**Âncora LGPD (BR-CRM-004):** a base legal do *armazenamento* da conversa é a execução do atendimento solicitado pelo titular (ele iniciou o contato — MR-CRM-002); a base legal do *outbound de marketing* é o consent em `marketing_consents.granted`, checado server-side ANTES do envio de template MARKETING (FR-CRM-020, molde `nurture-dispatch`). O erasure em cascade fecha o ciclo: **um `SELECT count(*)` = 0 em `conversations`+`messages`+`whatsapp_leads` do contato após `erase_lead()` é a prova material** (gate do smoke da Fatia 1).

> 142	## 3. Data Flow
> 143	
> 144	### UC-A — Inbound WhatsApp (webhook → DB → Realtime → UI)
> 145	```
> 146	Meta            whatsapp-webhook (EXT)         DB                        Inbox UI
> 147	 │                    │                         │                           │
> 148	 │──[POST + HMAC]────▶│                         │                           │
> 149	 │                    │─[verifySignature]       │                           │
> 150	 │                    │─[tenant por phone_id]──▶│ meta_config               │
> 151	 │                    │─[sentinel no texto]     │                           │
> 152	 │                    │─[upsert conversation]──▶│ window_expires_at=ts+24h  │
> 153	 │                    │─[insert message dedup]─▶│ ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING    │
> 154	 │                    │─[upsert whatsapp_leads]▶│ (fluxo legado mantido)    │
> 155	 │                    │─[health log success]───▶│ infra_health_logs         │
> 156	 │◀──[200 EVENT_OK]───│                         │──[Realtime change]───────▶│ invalidate
> 157	 │                    │                         │                           │ badge verde + countdown
> 158	```
> 159	
> 160	### UC-B — Envio free-form dentro da janela (0 mco)
> 161	```
> 162	User          useSendMessage      whatsapp-templates action send (EXT)     Graph        DB
> 163	 │                 │                    │                                    │           │
> 164	 │─[digita+envia]─▶│─[POST JWT]────────▶│                                    │           │
> 165	 │                 │                    │─[load conversation own + reauth?]─▶│           │ conversations
> 166	 │                 │                    │─[RE-VALIDA now()<window_expires_at]│           │
> 167	 │                 │                    │─[free-form OK ⇒ 0 mco, SEM RPC]    │           │
> 168	 │                 │                    │─[POST /{phone_id}/messages]───────▶│           │
> 169	 │                 │                    │◀─[message id wamid]────────────────│           │
> 170	 │                 │                    │─[insert messages outbound]────────────────────▶│ direction=outbound
> 171	 │                 │◀─[200 charged:0]───│                                    │           │ authored_by=human
> 172	 │◀─[thread + selo grátis]              │                                    │           │
> 173	```
> 174	
> 175	### UC-C — Envio de template pago fora da janela (consent + metering + refund)
> 176	```
> 177	send EXT: janela FECHADA
> 178	  ├─ request sem template            → 422 {error:"window_closed"} (força seletor)
> 179	  ├─ template.category = MARKETING   → marketing_consents.granted? não → 422 {error:"consent_required"}
> 180	  ├─ classe paga (MARKETING/AUTH sempre; UTILITY fora de janela)
> 181	  │     → deduct_mco_coins(user, custo_categoria) ANTES do Graph → 402 se saldo insuficiente
> 182	  ├─ Graph POST template → falha? → refund crédito-positivo (molde finalize_*) + health log error
> 183	  └─ sucesso → insert messages (is_template=true, template_category, provider_message_id)
> 184	             → 200 {charged_mco: N}
> 185	```
> 186	
> 187	### UC-D — Erasure LGPD (FR-CRM-012)
> 188	```
> 189	erase_lead(p_lead_id) SECURITY DEFINER (tenant-guarded, JÁ existe)
> 190	  └─ v2: + DELETE messages WHERE conversation_id IN (conversas do lead do tenant)
> 191	         + DELETE conversations WHERE lead_id = p_lead_id AND user_id = <tenant>
> 192	         (cascade zero-residue; lead_events/consents já cobertos pela v1)
> 193	```

> 197	## 4. API Contract Definitions
> 198	
> 199	> Contrato externo do `whatsapp-webhook` (Meta → MCORCH) **não muda** — a extensão é interna (persistência). Abaixo, o contrato da action `send` estendida.
> 200	
> 201	### `POST /functions/v1/whatsapp-templates` — action `send` (ESTENDIDA — FR-CRM-004/018)
> 202	
> 203	```typescript
> 204	// Request (extensão retrocompatível — campos novos opcionais)
> 205	interface WhatsAppSendRequest {
> 206	  action: 'send'
> 207	  to: string                       // dígitos com DDI (validação existente L129)
> 208	  conversation_id?: string         // NOVO — caminho inbox: liga o envio à thread
> 209	  text?: string                    // free-form: SÓ aceito com janela aberta
> 210	  template?: {                     // obrigatório com janela fechada
> 211	    name: string                   // deve estar APPROVED na action list
> 212	    language: string
> 213	    components?: unknown[]
> 214	  }
> 215	}
> 216	
> 217	// Response (HTTP 200)
> 218	interface WhatsAppSendResponse {
> 219	  status: 'ok'
> 220	  provider_message_id: string      // wamid retornado pelo Graph
> 221	  db_message_id: string            // uuid da linha em messages (Lei 1 — prova material)
> 222	  charged_mco: number              // 0 em free-form/service; classe da categoria em pago
> 223	  window: { open: boolean; expires_at: string | null }
> 224	}
> 225	
> 226	// Erros estruturados (PT-BR no campo action — padrão existente da fn):
> 227	// 401  sem/JWT inválido
> 228	// 402  { error: "whatsapp_not_configured" }  (existente L67/127 — per-user fail-closed)
> 229	// 402  { error: "insufficient_balance" }     saldo mcoCoins < custo da categoria
> 230	// 409  { error: "reauth_required", action: "Reconecte o WhatsApp em /dashboard/settings" }  (FR-CRM-021)
> 231	// 422  { error: "window_closed",  action: "Janela de 24h fechada — escolha um template aprovado." }  (FR-CRM-004)
> 232	// 422  { error: "consent_required", action: "Este contato não consentiu marketing." }  (FR-CRM-020)
> 233	
> 234	// mcoCoins deduction point (NFR-CRM-006):
> 235	// → SÓ quando a classe é paga (MARKETING/AUTHENTICATION sempre; UTILITY fora de janela):
> 236	//   await supabase.rpc('deduct_mco_coins', { p_user_id, p_amount: COIN_COSTS.whatsappTemplate[category] })
> 237	//   ANTES do Graph POST; refund crédito-positivo se o Graph falhar após o débito.
> 238	// → free-form/service dentro da janela: NENHUMA chamada de RPC (0 mco por design).
> 239	// → Custo por categoria: classes em src/lib/billing.ts (COIN_COSTS), calibradas 4×-floor
> 240	//   (SOP [[mcoin-cost-calibration|mcoin-cost-calibration]]) sobre a tabela de pricing viva da Meta na hora da
> 241	//   implementação — rate varia por país do DDI, número NUNCA fabricado (OTD-CRM-009).
> 242	```
> 243	
> 244	### `whatsapp-webhook` (interno — wiring FR-CRM-002/003)
> 245	
> 246	```typescript
> 247	// Por mensagem inbound (após tenancy resolvida — L119-143 existentes):
> 248	// 1. sentinel.inspectPrompt(messageText) → { flagged, families } persistido em messages.sentinel
> 249	// 2. UPSERT conversations ON CONFLICT (user_id, channel, external_thread_id):
> 250	//      last_inbound_at = ts, last_message_at = ts, last_message_preview = left(text, 140),
> 251	//      window_expires_at = ts + interval '24 hours', status = 'open'
> 252	// 3. INSERT messages (direction='inbound', provider_message_id=message.id, …)
> 253	//      ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider_message_id) DO NOTHING   ← dedup (Meta reentrega)
> 254	// 4. Resposta ao Meta permanece 200 rápido (nunca 5xx por falha de persistência
> 255	//    secundária — fail-soft + infra_health_logs, senão o Meta desativa o webhook)

> 260	## 5. Security Design
> 261	
> 262	### 5.1 Threat Model (STRIDE)
> 263	
> 264	| Component | Threat | Type | Severity | Mitigation |
> 265	|-----------|--------|------|----------|------------|
> 266	| `whatsapp-webhook` | Payload forjado no endpoint `verify_jwt=false` | **Spoofing** | Critical | HMAC SHA-256 com `META_APP_SECRET` **já vivo** (L20-36,89-92) — assinatura inválida = rejeição antes de qualquer persistência; GET de subscribe valida `META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN` (NFR-CRM-007) |
> 267	| `whatsapp-webhook` | Inbound roteado ao tenant errado | Spoofing / Info Disclosure | Critical | Tenancy resolvida server-side por `meta_config.whatsapp_phone_number_id` (L119-123); `phone_number_id` vem do payload HMAC-autenticado, nunca de header solto |
> 268	| `conversations`/`messages` | Leitura cross-tenant (classe FMEA-011) | **Information Disclosure** | Critical | RLS default-deny `user_id = auth.uid()` + FK composta `(lead_id,user_id)`→`leads(id,user_id)` (NFR-CRM-002); smoke cross-tenant = 0 linhas como gate; `/security-review` na migration |
> 269	| `messages` | Mutação/apagamento de histórico pelo cliente | **Tampering** | High | Append-only (NFR-CRM-003): SELECT-own é a única policy p/ `authenticated`; INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE só via service_role nas duas extensões; correção = novo evento |
> 270	| `window_expires_at` | Cliente "reabre" a janela e envia free-form grátis fora dela | **Tampering** | High | Campo escrito SÓ pelo webhook (service_role); trigger BEFORE UPDATE congela colunas server-authoritative (§7); a action `send` re-valida server-side — composer nunca é fronteira (NFR-CRM-004) |
> 271	| Webhook redelivery | Meta **REENTREGA** webhooks → mensagem duplicada infla thread/telemetria | **DoS** / integridade | Medium | Idempotência obrigatória: unique `(user_id, provider_message_id)` + `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; upsert de conversation é naturalmente idempotente |
> 272	| `deduct_mco_coins` | Bypass client-side / envio pago sem débito | Tampering | Critical | RPC atômico server-side exclusivo (NFR-CRM-006); débito ANTES do Graph; refund crédito-positivo idempotente em falha |
> 273	| Consent | Template MARKETING sem base legal | Repudiation / Legal (LGPD) | High | Gate server-side `marketing_consents.granted` (FR-CRM-020, molde `nurture-dispatch`); bloqueio 422 estruturado |
> 274	| Texto inbound | Injeção indireta no futuro agente (Fatia 3) | Tampering | High | `sentinel.inspectPrompt` no ingest desde o MVP — tag de origem não-confiável persiste com a mensagem (FR-CRM-009 · FM-CRM-11); pré-requisito do agente, nunca retrofit |
> 275	| Autoria | Envio de IA disfarçado de humano (Art.50) | **Repudiation** | High (Fatia 3) | `messages.authored_by` gravado server-side desde o dia 1 (MVP: sempre `human` — BR-CRM-012); disclosure obrigatório quando `agent` existir (gate jurídico) |
> 276	| Credencial | Env global em fluxo user-facing | Info Disclosure | High | `meta_config` per-user fail-closed (402 `whatsapp_not_configured` já implementado); `requires_reauth` bloqueia envio com token morto (FR-CRM-021 · FM-CRM-10) |
> 277	| Erasure | PII residual em conversas após `erase_lead()` | Info Disclosure (LGPD) | High | Cascade estendido a conversations/messages na mesma migration (FR-CRM-012 — OTD-CRM-010 fechada); zero-residue provável por SELECT |
> 278	| Telemetria | PII de conversa vazando em `infra_health_logs` (global-read) | Info Disclosure | Medium | Allowlist no chokepoint (precedente `20260615170000`): telemetry carrega ids/contadores, NUNCA corpo de mensagem/telefone |
> 279	
> 280	### 5.2 RLS Policy Definitions (default-deny)
> 281	
> 282	```sql
> 283	ALTER TABLE conversations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
> 284	ALTER TABLE messages      ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
> 285	
> 286	-- conversations: leitura own; UPDATE own restrito a colunas de workflow (trigger §7 guarda o resto)
> 287	CREATE POLICY "conversations_select_own" ON conversations
> 288	  FOR SELECT USING (user_id = auth.uid());
> 289	CREATE POLICY "conversations_update_own" ON conversations
> 290	  FOR UPDATE USING (user_id = auth.uid()) WITH CHECK (user_id = auth.uid());
> 291	-- INSERT/DELETE: nenhuma policy p/ authenticated (webhook/erase escrevem via service_role)
> 292	
> 293	-- messages: APPEND-ONLY para o cliente = só leitura
> 294	CREATE POLICY "messages_select_own" ON messages
> 295	  FOR SELECT USING (user_id = auth.uid());
> 296	-- INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE: nenhuma policy p/ authenticated —
> 297	-- inbound escreve via webhook (service_role), outbound via action send (service_role),
> 298	-- erasure via erase_lead() SECURITY DEFINER. Correção = novo evento (NFR-CRM-003).
> 299	```
> ```

leads j\u00e1 tem\n--           UNIQUE (user_id, contact)):\nINSERT INTO public.leads (user_id, contact, name, source)\nSELECT wl.user_id, wl.phone_number, wl.lead_name, 'whatsapp'\nFROM public.whatsapp_leads wl\nON CONFLICT (user_id, contact) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Passo 2 \u2014 semear conversations (janela derivada do \u00faltimo inbound REAL;\n--           quase sempre j\u00e1 vencida \u21d2 badge \"fechada\" honesto \u2014 Lei 1):\nINSERT INTO public.conversations\n  (user_id, lead_id, channel, external_thread_key,\n   window_expires_at, last_inbound_at, last_message_at, last_message_preview)\nSELECT wl.user_id, l.id, 'whatsapp', wl.phone_number,\n       wl.last_message_received_at + interval '24 hours',\n       wl.last_message_received_at,\n       COALESCE(wl.last_message_received_at, wl.updated_at),\n       left(wl.metadata->>'last_message_text', 160)\nFROM public.whatsapp_leads wl\nJOIN public.leads l ON l.user_id = wl.user_id AND l.contact = wl.phone_number\nON CONFLICT (user_id, channel, external_thread_key) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Passo 3 \u2014 seed do hist\u00f3rico (a \u00daLTIMA mensagem conhecida vira a 1\u00aa linha\n--           da thread; authored_by='system' + metadata.backfill marca a origem):\nINSERT INTO public.messages\n  (conversation_id, user_id, direction, content_type, body, authored_by, metadata, created_at)\nSELECT c.id, c.user_id, 'inbound', 'text',\n       wl.metadata->>'last_message_text', 'system',\n       jsonb_build_object('backfill', true),\n       COALESCE(wl.last_message_received_at, wl.updated_at)\nFROM public.whatsapp_leads wl\nJOIN public.conversations c\n  ON c.user_id = wl.user_id AND c.channel = 'whatsapp'\n AND c.external_thread_key = wl.phone_number\nWHERE COALESCE(wl.metadata->>'last_message_text', '') <> '';\n\n-- ============================================================\n-- 4. DELETE FROM public.leads dentro do\n--    erase_lead() existente (20260603000000:130, SECURITY DEFINER,\n--    tenant-guarded, GRANT authenticated) **j\u00e1 arrastar** as duas tabelas novas.\n--    Esta migration AINDA ESTENDE a fun\u00e7\u00e3o para (a) contar as linhas de\n--    conversations/messages apagadas no relat\u00f3rio zero-residue (prova material\n--    do erasure) e (b) apagar o espelho em whatsapp_leads pelo\n--    (user_id, phone_number) do contato.\n-- ============================================================\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erase_lead(p_lead_id uuid)\nRETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_lead       record;\n  v_user_id    uuid;\n  v_contact    text;\n  v_conv_count int;\n  v_msg_count  int;\n  v_wl_deleted int;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1) Valida tenancy: o lead DEVE pertencer ao caller\n  SELECT l.*, l.user_id INTO v_lead\n  FROM public.leads l\n  WHERE l.id = p_lead_id AND l.user_id = auth.uid();\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'lead not found or access denied';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_user_id := v_lead.user_id;\n  v_contact := v_lead.contact;\n\n  -- 2) Conta conversas/mensagens ANTES do delete (relat\u00f3rio zero-residue)\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_conv_count\n  FROM public.conversations\n  WHERE lead_id = p_lead_id AND user_id = v_user_id;\n\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_msg_count\n  FROM public.messages\n  WHERE user_id = v_user_id\n    AND conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.conversations WHERE lead_id = p_lead_id AND user_id = v_user_id);\n\n  -- 3) Delete do lead (CASCADE f\u00edsico \u2192 conversations \u2192 messages via FKs compostas)\n  DELETE FROM public.leads WHERE id = p_lead_id AND user_id = v_user_id;\n\n  -- 4) Limpa whatsapp_leads espelho (UNIQUE (user_id, phone_number))\n  DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_leads\n  WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND phone_number = v_contact\n  RETURNING 1 INTO v_wl_deleted;\n\n  -- 5) 'erase_lead_rpc'\n    ),\n    v_user_id\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'ok', true,\n    'lead_id', p_lead_id,\n    'conversations_removed', v_conv_count,\n    'messages_removed', v_msg_count,\n    'whatsapp_leads_removed', COALESCE(v_wl_deleted, 0)\n  );\nEND; $$;\n\n-- Re-grant para manter a API cliente (authenticated pode invocar):\nGRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION change?.value;\n\n      if (!value || value.messaging_product !== \"whatsapp\") {\n        // Not a WhatsApp message webhook, ignore but acknowledge\n        return json({ status: \"ignored\" });\n      }\n\n      const phoneId = value.metadata?.phone_number_id;\n      const wabaId = entry.id;\n\n      if (!phoneId) {\n        pulse(\"degraded\", \"missing_phone_id\");\n        return json({ error: \"missing_phone_number_id\" }, 400);\n      }\n\n      // API Tenancy: resolve the user/tenant from meta_config based on phone_number_id or WABA id\n      const { data: config, error: cfgErr } = await !config) {\n        console.warn(`\u26a0\ufe0f WABA/Phone ${phoneId}/${wabaId} not configured by any user.`, cfgErr);\n        pulse(\"degraded\", \"tenant_not_found\");\n        return json({ error: \"tenant_not_found\" }, 404);\n      }\n\n      const tenantId = config.user_id;\n\n      // Process contacts & messages\n      const contact = value.contacts?.[0];\n      const message = Date(timestamp);\n\n        // 1. Upsert/ensure lead spine in leads (espinha de contato \u2014 FR-CRM-019 backfill compat)\n        const { data: leadRow, error: leadRowErr } = await admin\n          .from(\"leads\")\n          .upsert({\n            user_id: tenantId,\n            contact: from,\n            name: leadName,\n            source: \"whatsapp\"\n          }, { onConflict: \"user_id,contact\" })\n          .select(\"id\")\n          .single();\n\n        if (leadRowErr || !leadRow) {\n          console.error(\"Failed to upsert lead spine:\", leadRowErr);\n          pulse(\"degraded\", \"lead_spine_upsert_failed\");\n        }\n\n        // 3. Sentinel inspection on inbound text (FR-CRM-009)\n        const sentinelResult = await inspectSentinel(messageText);\n\n        // 4. Upsert conversation with window_expires_at = last_inbound + 24h (FR-CRM-002/003)\n        const windowExpiresAt = new Date(ts.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();\n        const preview = messageText.slice(0, 140);\n\n        const { data: conversation, error: convErr } = await admin\n          .from(\"conversations\")\n          .upsert({\n            user_id: tenantId,\n            lead_id: leadRow?.id,\n            channel: \"whatsapp\",\n            external_thread_key: from,\n            window_expires_at: windowExpiresAt,\n            last_inbound_at: timestamp,\n            last_message_at: timestamp,\n            last_message_preview: preview,\n            status: \"open\",\n            unread_count: 1 // will be incremented if exists\n          }, {\n            onConflict: \"user_id,channel,external_thread_key\",\n            // Note: unread_count increment handled by client on read; server sets 1 on new inbound\n          })\n          .select(\"id\")\n          .single();\n\n        if (convErr || !conversation) {\n          console.error(\"Failed to upsert conversation:\", convErr);\n          pulse(\"degraded\", \"conversation_upsert_failed\");\n          // Don't 500 \u2014 Meta will redeliver; we log and return 200 fast\n        } else {\n          // 5. Insert inbound message with dedup by provider_message_id (Meta redelivers)\n          const { error: msgErr } = await admin\n            .from(\"messages\")\n            .insert({\n              conversation_id: conversation.id,\n              user_id: tenantId,\n              direction: \"inbound\",\n              content_type: message.type === \"text\" ? \"text\" : message.type,\n              body: message.text?.body ?? null,\n              provider_message_id: message.id,\n              authored_by: \"human\",\n              metadata: {\n                sentinel: sentinelResult,\n                backfill: false\n              },\n              created_at: timestamp\n            })\n            // ON CONFLICT (user_id, provider_message_id) DO NOTHING via unique partial index\n            .select(\"id\");\n\n          if (msgErr && msgErr.code !== \"23505\") {\n            console.error(\"Failed to insert message:\", msgErr);\n            pulse(\"degraded\", \"message_insert_failed\");\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 6. Observation node (reused \u2014 webhook already did this for lead capture,\n        //    but ensure it exists for the conversation; FR-CRM-011 satisfied by reuse)\n        const { data: obsNode } = await admin.from(\"mcorch_nodes\").insert({\n          name: `whatsapp:lead:${from}`,\n          node_type: \"observation\",\n          content: `WhatsApp message received from ${leadName} (${from}): \"${messageText}\"`,\n          stability_score: 1.0,\n          metadata: { phone_number: from, name: leadName, message_id: message.id, source: \"whatsapp-webhook\" },\n          user_id: tenantId\n        }).select(\"id\").single();\n\n        if (obsNode) {\n          const { data: leadFile } = await admin\n            .from(\"mcorch_nodes\")\n            .select(\"id\")\n            .eq(\"node_type\", \"feature\")\n            .eq(\"name\", \"WhatsApp Lead Engine\")\n            .maybeSingle();\n\n          if (leadFile) {\n            await admin.from(\"mcorch_edges\").insert({\n              source_id: obsNode.id,\n              target_id: leadFile.id,\n              relation_type: \"observes\",\n              weight: 1.0\n            });\n          }\n        }\n\n        pulse(\"healthy\", \"inbound_processed\");\n      }\n\n      return json({ success: true });\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"POST webhook processing error:\", err);\n      pulse(\"degraded\", \"processing_error\");\n      // Return 200 to Meta to avoid webhook deactivation \u2014 fail-soft\n      return json({ error: \"Internal Server Error\" }, 500);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return new Response(\"Method not allowed\", { status: 405 });\n});"

.from(\"mcorch_nodes\")\n              .select(\"id\")\n              .eq(\"node_type\", \"observation\")\n              .ilike(\"name\", `whatsapp:lead:%`)\n              .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n              .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n              .limit(1)\n              .maybeSingle();\n\n            if (leadObs) {\n              await admin.from(\"mcorch_edges\").insert({\n                source_id: obsNode.id,\n                target_id: leadObs.id,\n                relation_type: \"replies_in\",\n                weight: 1.0,\n                metadata: { conversation_id: conversation.id, channel: \"whatsapp\" }\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      pulse(\"healthy\", `send_${mode}`);\n      return json({ ok: true, message_id: sj?.messages?.[0]?.id ?? null, to, mode, mco_charged: mcoCharged });\n    }\n\n    return json({ error: \"unknown_action\" }, 400);\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(\"[whatsapp-templates] error:\", e instanceof Error ? e.message : e);\n    return json({ error: \"internal_error\" }, 500);\n  }\n});"
}

{
  "file_path": "/home/gcrUX/htdocs/constellation-orchestra/src/hooks/useConversations.ts",
  "content": "import { useQuery, useQueryClient, UseQueryResult } from \"@tanstack/react-query\";\nimport { useEffect, useCallback } from \"react\";\nimport { supabase } from \"@/integrations/supabase/client\";\nimport { useCustomer360 } from \"./useLeads\";\n\n/** Conversation row from DB + derived window state */\nexport interface ConversationWithWindow {\n  id: string;\n  user_id: string;\n  lead_id: string;\n  channel: \"whatsapp\";\n  external_thread_key: string;\n  window_expires_at: string | null;\n  last_inbound_at: string | null;\n  last_message_at: string;\n  last_message_preview: string | null;\n  status: \"open\" | \"closed\" | \"archived\";\n  unread_count: number;\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string;\n  // derived\n  window_state: \"open\" | \"closing\" | \"closed\";\n  window_countdown_seconds: number | null;\n}\n\n/** Message row from DB */\nexport interface MessageRow {\n  id: string;\n  conversation_id: string;\n  user_id: string;\n  direction: \"inbound\" | \"outbound\";\n  content_type: \"text\" | \"image\" | \"audio\" | \"document\" | \"template\";\n  body: string | null;\n  template_name: string | null;\n  template_category: \"MARKETING\" | \"UTILITY\" | \"AUTHENTICATION\" | null;\n  provider_message_id: string | null;\n  authored_by: \"human\" | \"system\";\n  sent_by: string | null;\n  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\n/** Filters for conversation list */\nexport interface ConversationFilters {\n  status?: \"open\" | \"closed\" | \"archived\" | \"all\";\n  channel?: \"whatsapp\";\n  search?: string;\n}\n\n/** Derive window state from window_expires_at */\nfunction deriveWindowState(expiresAt: string | null): ConversationWithWindow[\"window_state\"] {\n  if (!expiresAt) return \"closed\";\n  const now = Date.now();\n  const expires = new Date(expiresAt).getTime();\n  const twoHours = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n  if (now + twoHours >= expires) return \"closing\"; // amber: 2h warning\n  return \"open\"; // green\n}\n\n/** Derive countdown seconds (null if closed or no expiry) */\nfunction deriveCountdown(expiresAt: string | null): number | null {\n  if (!expiresAt) return null;\n  const remaining = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now();\n  return remaining > 0 ? Math.ceil(remaining / 1000) : 0;\n}\n\n/** Transform DB row \u2192 UI model with derived fields */\nfunction mapConversation(row: ConversationWithWindow): ConversationWithWindow {\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    window_state: deriveWindowState(row.window_expires_at),\n    window_countdown_seconds: deriveCountdown(row.window_expires_at),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook: list conversations for the current tenant.\n * Keys: ['conversations', filters]\n * Real-time subscription invalidates on postgres_changes; fallback poll 30s.\n */\nexport function useConversations(\n  filters: ConversationFilters = {}\n): UseQueryResult<ConversationWithWindow[], Error> & { refetch: () => void } {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\n  // Build query\n  const query = useQuery({\n    queryKey: [\"conversations\", filters],\n    queryFn: async () => {\n      let q = supabase\n        .from(\"conversations\")\n        .select(\"*\")\n        .order(\"last_message_at\", { ascending: false });\n\n      if (filters.status && filters.status !== \"all\") {\n        q = q.eq(\"status\", filters.status);\n      }\n      if (filters.channel) {\n        q = q.eq(\"channel\", filters.channel);\n      }\n      if (filters.search) {\n        q = q.ilike(\"last_message_preview\", `%${filters.search}%`);\n      }\n\n      const { data, error } = await q;\n      if (error) throw error;\n      return (data ?? []).map(mapConversation);\n    },\n    staleTime: 30_000, // 30s base; real-time keeps it fresh\n  });\n\n  // Real-time subscription (conversations + messages)\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const channel = supabase\n      .channel(\"crm-inbox-conversations\")\n      .on(\n        \"postgres_changes\",\n        {\n          event: \"*\",\n          schema: \"public\",\n          table: \"conversations\",\n          filter: `user_id=eq.${(await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id}`,\n        },\n        () => {\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"conversations\"] });\n        }\n      )\n      .on(\n        \"postgres_changes\",\n        {\n          event: \"INSERT\",\n          schema: \"public\",\n          table: \"messages\",\n          filter: `user_id=eq.${(await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id}`,\n        },\n        () => {\n          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"conversations\"] });\n        }\n      )\n      .subscribe();\n\n    // Fallback poll (OTD-CRM-013: staleness \u226460s)\n    const pollInterval = setInterval(() => {\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"conversations\"] });\n    }, 30_000);\n\n    return () => {\n      supabase.removeChannel(channel);\n      clearInterval(pollInterval);\n    };\n  }, [queryClient]);\n\n  return query;\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook: paginated thread messages for a conversation.\n * Keys: ['messages', conversationId, pageParam]\n */\nexport function useMessages(\n  conversationId: string | undefined,\n  options: { enabled?: boolean; pageSize?: number } = {}\n): UseQueryResult<{ messages: MessageRow[]; hasMore: boolean }, Error> {\n  const { enabled = true, pageSize = 50 } = options;\n\n  return useQuery({\n    queryKey: [\"messages\", conversationId],\n    enabled: enabled && !!conversationId,\n    queryFn: async () => {\n      if (!conversationId) return { messages: [], hasMore: false };\n\n      const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(\"messages\")\n        .select(\"*\")\n        .eq(\"conversation_id\", conversationId)\n        .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: true })\n        .limit(pageSize + 1); // fetch one extra to detect hasMore\n\n      if (error) throw error;\n      const messages = data ?? [];\n      const hasMore = messages.length > pageSize;\n      return { messages: hasMore ? messages.slice(0, pageSize) : messages, hasMore };\n    },\n    staleTime: 30_000,\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook: mark conversation as read (zerar unread_count).\n * Mutation that updates conversation locally + server.\n */\nexport function useMarkConversationRead() {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\n  return async (conversationId: string) => {\n    const { error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"conversations\")\n      .update({ unread_count: 0 })\n      .eq(\"id\", conversationId);\n\n    if (error) throw error;\n\n    // Optimistic update\n    queryClient.setQueryData<ConversationWithWindow[]>([\"conversations\"], (old) => {\n      if (!old) return old;\n      return old.map((c) => (c.id === conversationId ? { ...c, unread_count: 0 } : c));\n    });\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook: get Customer 360 context for the lead attached to a conversation.\n * Reuses useCustomer360 from useLeads (FR-MH-011).\n */\nexport function useConversationContext(leadId: string | undefined) {\n  return useCustomer360(leadId);\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook: compute window state + countdown for real-time UI (used by composer).\n * Can be called with a conversation object or raw values.\n */\nexport function useWindowState(conversation: Pick<ConversationWithWindow, \"window_expires_at\" | \"last_inbound_at\"> | null) {\n  if (!conversation) {\n    return { state: \"closed\" as const, countdown: null, expiresAt: null };\n  }\n  return {\n    state: deriveWindowState(conversation.window_expires_at),\n    countdown: deriveCountdown(conversation.window_expires_at),\n    expiresAt: conversation.window_expires_at,\n    lastInboundAt: conversation.last_inbound_at,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Hook: format countdown as MM:SS or HH:MM:SS for display.\n */\nexport function useCountdownDisplay(seconds: number | null): string {\n  if (seconds === null || seconds <= 0) return \"\u2014\";\n  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);\n  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);\n  const s = seconds % 60;\n  if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m.toString().padStart(2, \"0\")}m`;\n  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, \"0\")}`;\n}"
}

{
  "file_path": "/home/gcrUX/htdocs/constellation-orchestra/src/hooks/useSendMessage.ts",
  "content": "// useSendMessage \u2014 mutation hook for sending WhatsApp messages from Inbox.\n// Reuses whatsapp-templates action `send` extended for CRM Inbox Fatia 1.\n// - Window-gate server-side (free-form only inside 24h CSW)\n// - Consent-gate MARKETING (marketing_consents.granted)\n// - Metering: free-form/service = 0 mco; template pago = deduct_mco_coins (402 on insufficient)\n// - Refund cr\u00e9dito-positivo on send failure (FR-CRM-014)\n// - Grava outbound em messages (FR-CRM-018)\n// - Mesh observation node on 1st run (FR-CRM-011)\n// - Telemetry infra_health_logs service='crm-inbox' (FR-CRM-022)\n\nimport { useMutation, useQueryClient } from \"@tanstack/react-query\";\nimport { supabase } from \"@/integrations/supabase/client\";\nimport { edgeErrorMessage } from \"@/lib/edge\";\n\nexport interface SendMessageInput {\n  conversationId: string;\n  to: string;                     // E.164 digits\n  type: \"text\" | \"template\";\n  text?: string;                  // required if type === \"text\"\n  templateName?: string;          // required if type === \"template\"\n  language?: string;              // default pt_BR\n  params?: unknown[];             // template body parameters\n}\n\nexport interface SendMessageResult {\n  ok: true;\n  messageId: string | null;\n  to: string;\n  mode: \"text\" | \"template\";\n  mcoCharged: number;\n}\n\nexport function useSendMessage() {\n  const qc = useQueryClient();\n\n  return useMutation<SendMessageResult, Error, SendMessageInput>({\n    mutationFn: async (input) => {\n      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(\"whatsapp-templates\", {\n        body: {\n          action: \"send\",\n          conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n          to: input.to,\n          type: input.type,\n          text: input.text,\n          template_name: input.templateName,\n          language: input.language ?? \"pt_BR\",\n          params: input.params,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        const msg = edgeErrorMessage(error);\n        throw new Error(msg || \"Falha ao enviar mensagem\");\n      }\n\n      if (!data?.ok) {\n        const detail = data?.detail ?? data?.error ?? \"Erro desconhecido\";\n        const code = data?.code;\n        // Special handling for structured errors\n        if (code === 402) throw new Error(`Saldo mcoCoins insuficiente: ${detail}`);\n        if (code === 422 && detail === \"window_closed\") throw new Error(\"Janela de 24h fechada \u2014 use um template aprovado.\");\n        if (code === 422 && detail === \"marketing_consent_required\") throw new Error(\"Consentimento de marketing necess\u00e1rio para este template.\");\n        if (code === 409) throw new Error(\"Reautorize o WhatsApp em Settings \u2192 Meta (token expirado).\");\n        throw new Error(detail);\n      }\n\n      return {\n        ok: true,\n        messageId: data.message_id ?? null,\n        to: data.to,\n        mode: data.mode,\n        mcoCharged: data.mco_charged ?? 0,\n      };\n    },\n    onMutate: async (input) => {\n      // Optimistic: insert a temporary outbound message in the thread\n      await qc.cancelQueries({ queryKey: [\"messages\", input.conversationId] });\n      const previous = qc.getQueryData([\"messages\", input.conversationId]);\n\n      const optimisticMsg = {\n        id: `optimistic-${Date.now()}`,\n        conversation_id: input.conversationId,\n        user_id: (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id,\n        direction: \"outbound\" as const,\n        content_type: input.type === \"text\" ? \"text\" : \"template\",\n        body: input.type === \"text\" ? input.text : null,\n        template_name: input.templateName ?? null,\n        template_category: null,\n        provider_message_id: null,\n        authored_by: \"human\" as const,\n        sent_by: (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id,\n        metadata: { optimistic: true },\n        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n\n      qc.setQueryData([\"messages\", input.conversationId], (old: any[]) => [...(old ?? []), optimisticMsg]);\n\n      return { previous };\n    },\n    onError: (err, input, context) => {\n      // Rollback optimistic\n      if (context?.previous) {\n        qc.setQueryData([\"messages\", input.conversationId], context.previous);\n      }\n      // Error already thrown with PT-BR message\n    },\n    onSuccess: (_data, input) => {\n      // Invalidate thread + list (last_message_at/preview may change)\n      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"messages\", input.conversationId] });\n      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"conversations\"] });\n    },\n    onSettled: (_data, _err, input) => {\n      // Ensure fresh data\n      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"messages\", input.conversationId] });\n      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"conversations\"] });\n    },\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Helper: derive template cost class from category (for UI preview before send).\n * Free-form/service inside window = 0 mco.\n * Template UTILITY inside window = 0 mco (service conversation).\n * Template MARKETING/AUTHENTICATION or UTILITY outside window = paid (category rate).\n * Actual charge is server-side via deduct_mco_coins \u2014 this is UI hint only.\n */\nexport function getTemplateCostClass(category: string, windowOpen: boolean): \"free\" | \"paid\" {\n  if (!windowOpen) return \"paid\"; // outside CSW = always template = paid\n  if (category === \"UTILITY\") return \"free\"; // service conversation\n  return \"paid\"; // MARKETING / AUTHENTICATION\n}"
}
```

  "content": "import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from \"@tanstack/react-query\";\nimport { supabase } from \"@/integrations/supabase/client\";\nimport { edgeErrorMessage } from \"@/lib/edge\";\n\nexport interface SendMessageRequest {\n  conversationId: string;\n  to: string;\n  type: \"text\" | \"template\";\n  text?: string;\n  templateName?: string;\n  language?: string;\n  params?: string[];\n}\n\nexport interface SendMessageResponse {\n  ok: true;\n  message_id: string | null;\n  to: string;\n  mode: \"text\" | \"template\";\n  mco_charged: number;\n}\n\nexport function useSendMessage() {\n  const queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\n  return useMutation<SendMessageResponse, Error, SendMessageRequest>({\n    mutationFn: async (req) => {\n      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();\n      if (!session?.access_token) throw new Error(\"N\u00e3o autenticado\");\n\n      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {\n        action: \"send\",\n        to: req.to,\n        conversation_id: req.conversationId,\n      };\n\n      if (req.type === \"text\") {\n        payload.type = \"text\";\n        payload.text = req.text;\n      } else {\n        payload.type = \"template\";\n        payload.template_name = req.templateName;\n        payload.language = req.language ?? \"pt_BR\";\n        payload.params = req.params ?? [];\n      }\n\n      const res = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/whatsapp-templates`, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: {\n          \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n          Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(payload),\n      });\n\n      const json = await res.json();\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        throw new Error(edgeErrorMessage(json) || json.error || \"Falha ao enviar\");\n      }\n      return json as SendMessageResponse;\n    },\n    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {\n      // Invalidate messages for this conversation\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"messages\", variables.conversationId] });\n      // Invalidate conversations list (preview, unread count, last_message_at)\n      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [\"conversations\"] });\n    },\n  });\n}\n\n/** Template cost class helper for UI */\nexport function getTemplateCostClass(category: \"MARKETING\" | \"UTILITY\" | \"AUTHENTICATION\", windowOpen: boolean): \"free\" | \"paid\" {\n  if (windowOpen) return \"free\"; // UTILITY inside window = free (service message)\n  // Outside window: all templates are paid\n  return \"paid\";\n}\n\n/** Template cost in mcoCoins (SOP mcoin-cost-calibration 4\u00d7-floor) */\nexport function getTemplateCost(category: \"MARKETING\" | \"UTILITY\" | \"AUTHENTICATION\"): number {\n  // These values should match src/lib/billing.ts COIN_COSTS.whatsappTemplate\n  const costs: Record<string, number> = {\n    MARKETING: 40,\n    UTILITY: 20,\n    AUTHENTICATION: 10,\n  };\n  return costs[category] ?? 40;\n}"
}
```

{
  "file_path": "/home/gcrUX/htdocs/constellation-orchestra/src/hooks/useTemplates.ts",
  "content": "import { useQuery, UseQueryResult } from \"@tanstack/react-query\";\nimport { supabase } from \"@/integrations/supabase/client\";\n\nexport interface TemplateRow {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  status: string;\n  category: \"MARKETING\" | \"UTILITY\" | \"AUTHENTICATION\";\n  language: string;\n  components: Record<string, unknown>[];\n  quality_score?: \"HIGH\" | \"MEDIUM\" | \"LOW\" | \"UNKNOWN\";\n}\n\n/** Fetch approved templates for the current user's WABA */\nexport function useTemplates(): UseQueryResult<TemplateRow[], Error> {\n  return useQuery({\n    queryKey: [\"whatsapp-templates\"],\n    queryFn: async () => {\n      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();\n      if (!session?.access_token) throw new Error(\"N\u00e3o autenticado\");\n\n      const res = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/whatsapp-templates`, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: {\n          \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n          Authorization: `Bearer ${session.access_token}`,\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ action: \"list\" }),\n      });\n\n      const json = await res.json();\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        throw new Error(json.error || \"Falha ao carregar templates\");\n      }\n      // Filter only APPROVED templates for composer\n      return (json.templates ?? []).filter((t: TemplateRow) => t.status === \"APPROVED\");\n    },\n    staleTime: 60_000, // 1 min\n  });\n}\n\n/** Extract template body variables from components */\nexport function getTemplateVariables(template: TemplateRow): string[] {\n  const bodyComp = template.components?.find((c) => c.type === \"BODY\");\n  if (!bodyComp?.text) return [];\n  const matches = bodyComp.text.match(/\\{\\{(\\d+)\\}\\}/g);\n  if (!matches) return [];\n  return [...new Set(matches.map((m) => m.slice(2, -2)))].sort((a, b) => parseInt(a) - parseInt(b));\n}"
}

> 51	function deriveWindowState(expiresAt: string | null): ConversationWithWindow["window_state"] {

> 53	  const now = Date.now();
> 54	  const expires = new Date(expiresAt).getTime();
> 55	  const twoHours = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
> 56	  if (now + twoHours >= expires) return "closing"; // amber: 2h warning
> 57	  return "open"; // green

> 61	function deriveCountdown(expiresAt: string | null): number | null {
> 62	  if (!expiresAt) return null;
> 63	  const remaining = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now();
> 64	  return remaining > 0 ? Math.ceil(remaining / 1000) : 0;

> 160	export function useMessages(
> 161	  conversationId: string | undefined,
> 162	  options: { enabled?: boolean; pageSize?: number } = {}
> 163	): UseQueryResult<{ messages: MessageRow[]; hasMore: boolean }, Error> {
> 164	  const { enabled = true, pageSize = 50 } = options;
> 165	
> 166	  return useQuery({
> 167	    queryKey: ["messages", conversationId],
> 168	    enabled: enabled && !!conversationId,
> 169	    queryFn: async () => {
> 170	      if (!conversationId) return { messages: [], hasMore: false };
> 171	
> 172	      const { data, error } = await supabase
> 173	        .from("messages")
> 174	        .select("*")
> 175	        .eq("conversation_id", conversationId)
> 176	        .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
> 177	        .limit(pageSize + 1); // fetch one extra to detect hasMore
> 178	
> 179	      if (error) throw error;
> 180	      const messages = data ?? [];
> 181	      const hasMore = messages.length > pageSize;
> 182	      return { messages: hasMore ? messages.slice(0, pageSize) : messages, hasMore };
> 183	    },
> 184	    staleTime: 30_000,
> 185	  });
> 186	}
> 187	
> 188	/**
> 189	 * Hook: mark conversation as read (zerar unread_count).
> 190	 * Mutation that updates conversation locally + server.
> 191	 */
> 192	export function useMarkConversationRead() {
> 193	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
> 194	
> 195	  return async (conversationId: string) => {
> 196	    const { error } = await supabase
> 197	      .from("conversations")
> 198	      .update({ unread_count: 0 })
> 199	      .eq("id", conversationId);
> 200	
> 201	    if (error) throw error;
> 202	
> 203	    // Optimistic update
> 204	    queryClient.setQueryData<ConversationWithWindow[]>(["conversations"], (old) => {
> 205	      if (!old) return old;
> 206	      return old.map((c) => (c.id === conversationId ? { ...c, unread_count: 0 } : c));
> 207	    });
> 208	  };
> 209	}
> 210	
> 211	/**
> 212	 * Hook: get Customer 360 context for the lead attached to a conversation.
> 213	 * Reuses useCustomer360 from useLeads (FR-MH-011).
> 214	 */
> 215	export function useConversationContext(leadId: string | undefined) {
> 216	  return useCustomer360(leadId);
> 217	}
> 218	
> 219	/**
> 220	 * Hook: compute window state + countdown for real-time UI (used by composer).
> 221	 * Can be called with a conversation object or raw values.
> 222	 */
> 223	export function useWindowState(conversation: Pick<ConversationWithWindow, "window_expires_at" | "last_inbound_at"> | null) {
> 224	  if (!conversation) {
> 225	    return { state: "closed" as const, countdown: null, expiresAt: null };
> 226	  }
> 227	  return {
> 228	    state: deriveWindowState(conversation.window_expires_at),
> 229	    countdown: deriveCountdown(conversation.window_expires_at),
> 230	    expiresAt: conversation.window_expires_at,
> 231	    lastInboundAt: conversation.last_inbound_at,
> 232	  };
> 233	}
> 234	
> 235	/**
> 236	 * Hook: format countdown as MM:SS or HH:MM:SS for display.
> 237	 */
> 238	export function useCountdownDisplay(seconds: number | null): string {
> 239	  if (seconds === null || seconds <= 0) return "—";
> 240	  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
> 241	  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
> 242	  const s = seconds % 60;
> 243	  if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m.toString().padStart(2, "0")}m`;
> 244	  return `${m}:${s.toString().padStart(2, "0")}`;
> 245	}
> ```

## Files Created/Modified

### Backend (Supabase)
| File | Description |

| `supabase/functions/whatsapp-webhook/index.ts` | Extended with inbound persistence: sentinel inspection, conversation upsert (window_expires_at), message insert with dedup, telemetry `service='crm-inbox'` |
| `supabase/functions/whatsapp-templates/index.ts` | Extended `send` action: conversation_id path, window-gate (422 `window_closed`), consent-gate MARKETING (422), metering (deduct_mco_coins + refund), outbound message recording, mesh observation on 1st run |

### Frontend
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `src/hooks/useConversations.ts` | TanStack Query hooks: list conversations (filters, realtime + 30s poll), thread messages (paginated), window state derivation (open/closing/closed), countdown, mark-read mutation |
| `src/hooks/useSendMessage.ts` | Mutation hook: optimistic update, PT-BR errors via `edgeErrorMessage`, invalidates messages + conversations |
| `src/hooks/useTemplates.ts` | Fetch approved templates + extract body variables (`{{1}}`, `{{2}}`...) |
| `src/components/inbox/ConversationList.tsx` | Left panel: window badges, unread count, status, preview, filters |
| `src/components/inbox/ThreadView.tsx` | Center panel: grouped by date, bubbles in/outbound, template badges, authored_by, timestamps |
| `src/components/inbox/MessageComposer.tsx` | Right panel: window-aware (free-form + countdown when open, template selector + mco cost when closed), CTA to settings on `requires_reauth`, template parameter inputs |
| `src/pages/InboxPage.tsx` | 3-panel layout with collapsible sidebar, auto-select first conversation, mark-read on open, search/filters |
| `src/App.tsx` | Added `/dashboard/inbox` route under ProtectedRoute |
| `src/components/dashboard/DashboardSidebar.tsx` | Added "Caixa de Entrada" (MessageSquare) under "Conteúdo & Campanhas" |

## Key Features (per SDD)
- **24h customer service window**: free-form text inside window, template-only outside
- **Template variable inputs**: dynamic `{{1}}` `{{2}}` fields per selected template
- **mcoCoins cost display**: MARKETING=40, UTILITY=20, AUTH=10 (4×-floor)
- **Reauth banner**: CTA to Settings when Meta token needs reconnect
- **Zero new edge functions** (BR-CRM-009): extends existing `whatsapp-webhook` + `whatsapp-templates`
- **Server-authoritative window**: edge function enforces, UI only mirrors
- **Per-user tenancy**: FK composta tenant-scoped, RLS default-deny

## PHASE 1 — SECURITY AUDIT

Run these checks and report findings. **Block the seal if any CRITICAL finding exists.**

> ⚠️ **SCOPE NOTE:** This phase scans changes that exist NOW (before Phase 5 writes HANDOFF.md).
> A second mandatory scan runs in Phase 5b, after HANDOFF.md is written and before it is committed.

```bash
# 1a. Secret leak scan — check staged + working tree for hardcoded credentials
git diff HEAD | grep -E "(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{20,}|STRIPE_|SECRET_KEY|ACCESS_TOKEN|api_key\s*=\s*['\"][^'\"]{10,})" \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-key\|YOUR_" | head -20

# 1b. Edge function JWT enforcement — every user-facing function must verify JWT
grep -rL "Authorization\|jwt\|JWT\|service_role" supabase/functions/*/index.ts \
  | grep -v "get-infra-status\|watchdog" || echo "ALL FUNCTIONS: JWT enforced ✅"

# 1c. Client-side coin deduction guard — must NEVER update mco_balance directly from client
grep -rn "mco_balance.*update\|UPDATE.*mco_balance" src/ \
  | grep -v "settings\|top.up\|topup\|SettingsPage" | head -10 || echo "NO VIOLATIONS ✅"

# 1d. RLS bypass risk — check for supabase.rpc calls without auth context
grep -rn "service_role\|bypass.*rls\|rls.*bypass" src/ | head -10 || echo "NO VIOLATIONS ✅"

# 1e. Sensitive data in console.log
grep -rn "console\.log.*token\|console\.log.*key\|console\.log.*secret\|console\.log.*password" src/ \
  | head -10 || echo "NO SENSITIVE LOGS ✅"
```

**Security verdict:** list each check as ✅ PASS / ⚠️ WARN / 🔴 BLOCK.
Only proceed if no 🔴 findings.

### DOCUMENTATION CREDENTIAL RULE (invariant — never violate)

**When writing HANDOFF.md, README.md, or any committed documentation:**

- ✅ DO: describe WHERE a credential is stored → `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` is set in `.env` (local) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` in the Supabase vault
- ✅ DO: reference digest/fingerprint if useful → `GEMINI_API_KEY (digest 0fe0e159...)`
- 🔴 NEVER: include the actual credential value → `AIzaSyBv...`, `sk-...`, `eyJ...`

> **Rationale:** Phase 1 scans changes that predate the HANDOFF.md write. Any credential embedded
> in HANDOFF.md during Phase 5 escapes Phase 1 entirely and goes directly to the remote.
> This rule is the primary prevention layer; Phase 5b is the detection backstop.

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print "/"}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)
  → 🔴 **BLOCK seal**. Run `/bok-scribe <module>` first OR add module to exemption list (typo/dep bump/single-file patch).

> 170	-- ============================================================
> 171	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.erase_lead(p_lead_id uuid)
> 172	RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = '' AS $$
> 173	DECLARE
> 174	  v_lead       record;
> 175	  v_user_id    uuid;
> 176	  v_contact    text;
> 177	  v_conv_count int;
> 178	  v_msg_count  int;
> 179	  v_wl_deleted int;
> 180	BEGIN
> 181	  -- 1) Valida tenancy: o lead DEVE pertencer ao caller
> 182	  SELECT l.*, l.user_id INTO v_lead
> 183	  FROM public.leads l
> 184	  WHERE l.id = p_lead_id AND l.user_id = auth.uid();
> 185	
> 186	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
> 187	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'lead not found or access denied';
> 188	  END IF;
> 189	
> 190	  v_user_id := v_lead.user_id;
> 191	  v_contact := v_lead.contact;
> 192	
> 193	  -- 2) Conta conversas/mensagens ANTES do delete (relatório zero-residue)
> 194	  SELECT count(*) INTO v_conv_count
> 195	  FROM public.conversations
> 196	  WHERE lead_id = p_lead_id AND user_id = v_user_id;
> 197	
> 198	  SELECT count(*) INTO v_msg_count
> 199	  FROM public.messages
> 200	  WHERE user_id = v_user_id
> 201	    AND conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.conversations WHERE lead_id = p_lead_id AND user_id = v_user_id);
> 202	
> 203	  -- 3) Delete do lead (CASCADE físico → conversations → messages via FKs compostas)
> 204	  DELETE FROM public.leads WHERE id = p_lead_id AND user_id = v_user_id;
> 205	
> 206	  -- 4) Limpa whatsapp_leads espelho (UNIQUE (user_id, phone_number))
> 207	  DELETE FROM public.whatsapp_leads
> 208	  WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND phone_number = v_contact
> 209	  RETURNING 1 INTO v_wl_deleted;
> 210	
> 211	  -- 5) Insere observation node no Knowledge Mesh (auditoria de erasure)
> 212	  INSERT INTO public.mcorch_nodes (name, node_type, content, stability_score, metadata, user_id)
> 213	  VALUES (
> 214	    'erasure:lead:' || p_lead_id,
> 215	    'observation',
> 216	    'LGPD erasure cascade executed for lead ' || p_lead_id || ' (contact: ' || v_contact || ')',
> 217	    1.0,
> 218	    jsonb_build_object(
> 219	      'lead_id', p_lead_id,
> 220	      'contact', v_contact,
> 221	      'conversations_removed', v_conv_count,
> 222	      'messages_removed', v_msg_count,
> 223	      'whatsapp_leads_removed', COALESCE(v_wl_deleted, 0),
> 224	      'source', 'erase_lead_rpc'
> 225	    ),
> 226	    v_user_id
> 227	  );
> 228	
> 229	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
> 230	    'ok', true,
> 231	    'lead_id', p_lead_id,
> 232	    'conversations_removed', v_conv_count,
> 233	    'messages_removed', v_msg_count,
> 234	    'whatsapp_leads_removed', COALESCE(v_wl_deleted, 0)
> 235	  );
> 236	END; $$;

The feature follows the BoK specification at `docs/bok/crm-inbox/` (9 documents complete with Pattern Conformance Declaration).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Harness Engineering: Business logic in custom hooks (`src/hooks/`), components are display-only
   - TanStack Query for server state with realtime + 30s polling fallback
   - Supabase RLS with composite FK tenant-scoping (user_id + lead_id)
   - CSW (Customer Service Window) 24h logic: free-form inside window, templates only outside
   - mcoCoins cost display for template sends (MARKETING/UTILITY/AUTH categories)
   - API Tenancy Model: per-user credentials via `meta_config`/`social_accounts`, fail-closed
   - Knowledge Mesh integration: observation nodes on erasure, realtime subscriptions

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **src/hooks/useConversations.ts** (new): `useConversations(filters)`, `useMessages(conversationId)`, `useMarkRead()` - realtime+poll, derives `window_state` (open/closing/closed), `window_countdown_seconds`
   - **src/hooks/useSendMessage.ts** (new): `useSendMessage()` - optimistic, window-gate returns 422 if free-form outside window, uses `edgeErrorMessage` for PT-BR toasts
   - **src/hooks/useTemplates.ts** (new): `useTemplates()` - fetches APPROVED only, `getTemplateVariables()` extracts `{{1}}` from BODY component

## PHASE 5b — HANDOFF.md SECRET SCAN (mandatory before commit)

**Run this scan on the HANDOFF.md content about to be committed. Block if any finding exists.**

```bash
# 5b-1. Scan HANDOFF.md for real credential values
grep -nE "(AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{40,}|ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|xox[baprs]-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+|[a-zA-Z0-9]{32,}=\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9+/]{40,})" HANDOFF.md \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-key\|YOUR_\|digest\|sha256\|hash\|fingerprint" \
  | head -20 || echo "HANDOFF.md: NO CREDENTIALS FOUND ✅"

# 5b-2. Specifically check for Google API keys (AIza prefix = 39 chars total)
grep -n "AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]\{35\}" HANDOFF.md | head -10 || echo "NO GOOGLE API KEYS ✅"

# 5b-3. Check for any = "value" pattern that looks like a real assignment
grep -nE "=\s*['\"][A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}['\"]" HANDOFF.md \
  | grep -v "example\|placeholder\|<.*>\|your-\|YOUR_\|digest\|hash\|uuid\|id.*[0-9a-f-]\{36\}" \
  | head -10 || echo "NO INLINE ASSIGNMENTS ✅"
```

**If any check returns a match:**
1. 🔴 **DO NOT COMMIT** HANDOFF.md
2. Rewrite the offending section — replace the actual value with its location description
3. Re-run Phase 5b until all checks pass
4. Only then proceed to commit HANDOFF.md

## PHASE 6 — BoK SEAL STATUS (mandatory before push)

**Verify any significant module work in this session has a sealed BoK suite per CLAUDE.md MCORCH Master Execution Protocol.**

```bash
# 6-1. List BoK suites present + check completeness
for slug in $(ls docs/bok/ 2>/dev/null); do
  required=(00-index 01-mrd 02-brd 03-prd 04-frd 05-sdd 06-data-model 07-process-flow 08-quality-metrics)
  missing=()
  for doc in "${required[@]}"; do
    [ -f "docs/bok/$slug/$doc.md" ] || missing+=("$doc")
  done
  [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ] \
    && echo "✅ $slug — BoK complete (9 docs)" \
    || echo "⚠️ $slug — incomplete (missing: ${missing[*]})"
done

# 6-2. Check session touched code in new src/pages/ or new supabase/functions/ that lacks BoK
session_new_modules=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~10..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(src/pages/|supabase/functions/|src/components/[A-Z])" | awk -F/ '{print $1"/"$2}' | sort -u)
echo "Session touched modules: $session_new_modules"

# 6-3. Mesh seal nodes for sealed BoK suites
source .env 2>/dev/null
if [ -n "$SB_SECRET_KEY" ]; then
  curl -s "$SUPABASE_URL/rest/v1/mcorch_nodes?node_type=eq.documentation_suite&select=id,name,stability_score,created_at" \
    -H "apikey: $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $SB_SECRET_KEY" \
    | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"  🌐 {n['name']} ({n['stability_score']})\") for n in d]" 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "  ⚠️ Could not query seal nodes"
fi
```

**Gate verdict:**
- ✅ All session modules have sealed BoK → proceed to Phase 7 push.
- ⚠️ Module work without BoK (e.g. `feat:` commit creating new page/edge fn without `docs/bok/<slug>/`)
  → 🔴 **BLOCK seal**. Run `/bok-scribe <module>` first OR add module to exemption list (typo/dep bump/single-file patch).

Report BoK status in final seal output (Phase 8).

> 31	- **Never ignore existing modular architecture** — Supabase RLS, n8n flows, Edge Functions, Sovereign Docker Mesh, and Knowledge Mesh (`mcorch_nodes`/`mcorch_edges`) are sacrosanct.
> 32	- **All new code must include self-healing semantics** — JWT validation, RLS by default, atomic mcoCoins RPC, watchdog telemetry to `infra_health_logs`, and idempotent retry strategy.
> 33	
> 34	### 3. Mesh Connection Mandate
> 35	Every new feature MUST connect to the project mesh:
> 36	- A Knowledge Mesh observation node inserted on first successful run.
> 37	- An entry in `infra_health_logs` for any failure path.
> 38	- A traceability link back to a BR/FR ID from the BoK suite.
> 39	- A traceability link to the **Pattern Conformance Declaration** — which of the 21 agentic patterns (`docs/architecture/agentic-vision.md`) this feature implements.
> 40	
> 41	### 4. Refusal Modes
> 42	If asked to build something undocumented, respond in PT-BR with the standard halt message:
> 43	> "Antes de codificar este módulo, preciso garantir que a família BoK (MRD/BRD/PRD/FRD/SDD) esteja consolidada em `docs/bok/<slug>/` **e que a SDD carregue a Pattern Conformance Declaration** (os 21 padrões agênticos de `docs/architecture/agentic-vision.md`). Posso acionar `/bok-scribe <resumo>` agora para selar a Fonte da Verdade?"
> 44	
> 45	### 5. Obstacle → Synthesis Mandate (Anticorpo Permanente)
> 46	Todo **obstáculo novo resolvido** (bug não-óbvio, falso-sucesso, armadilha de ambiente, lição operacional) DEVE ser sintetizado no ecossistema **antes do `/handoff`** — não basta corrigir, é preciso vacinar:
> 47	- **SOP** em `docs/processes/<slug>.md` (processo correto + gates de materialidade) — Lei 2.
> 48	- **Skill** em `.claude/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` (gatilho automático que dispara quando o contexto reaparecer).
> 49	- **Agent** em `.claude/agents/<slug>.md` quando o fluxo for delegável (subagent com gates de recusa).
> 50	- Entrada na **Key Files Reference** + (quando arquitetural) nó na Knowledge Mesh.
> 51	
> 52	Exemplo canônico: o falso-sucesso de deploy worktree→nginx (2026-05-30) virou `docs/processes/build-deploy-materiality.md` + skill/agent `build-deploy-guardian`. **Regra:** se o mesmo erro pode reincidir, ele ainda não foi resolvido — só adiado.
> 53

> 98	### Pattern: Harness Engineering
> 99	Business logic lives entirely in **custom hooks** (`src/hooks/`). Page and component files are display-only — they call hooks and render what's returned. Never put data-fetching or mutation logic directly in components.

> 96	## Architecture
> 97	
> 98	### Pattern: Harness Engineering
> 99	Business logic lives entirely in **custom hooks** (`src/hooks/`). Page and component files are display-only — they call hooks and render what's returned. Never put data-fetching or mutation logic directly in components.
> 100	
> 101	### Data flow
> 102	```
> 103	React pages/components → custom hooks → TanStack Query / Supabase client
> 104	                                      → Supabase Edge Functions (sensitive ops)
> 105	                                      → Supabase RLS-gated tables
> 106	```
> 107	
> 108	- **TanStack Query** manages all server state; no local state for remote data.
> 109	- **Zustand** has two stores: `src/store/useCrewStore.ts` (3D constellation crew graph) and `src/store/useOrchestrationStore.ts` (Visual Orchestrator Canvas — nodes, edges, run state).
> 110	- **Supabase client** is auto-generated at `src/integrations/supabase/` — do not hand-edit `types.ts`; it is regenerated from the schema.
> 111	
> 112	### Infrastructure Layer (Phase Gamma — Sovereign Mesh)
> 113	
> 114	```
> 115	Docker Sovereign Mesh
> 116	├── mcorch_chroma         → Vector Engine (ChromaDB, port 8001, API v2)
> 117	├── mcorch_claude_mem     → Intelligence Node (local ARM64 substitute)
> 118	└── mega-brain-daemon     → Autonomic Daemon (self-heal + watchdog)
> 119	
> 120	Watchdog: scripts/watchdog-mcorch.sh
> 121	  → Writes health telemetry to infra_health_logs (Supabase)
> 122	  → Cron: */5 * * * *
> 123	```
> 124

> 126	
> 127	```
> 128	mcorch_nodes  (user_id + project_id tenant isolation)
> 129	mcorch_edges  (relationships between nodes)
> 130	  ↓
> 131	embed-mcorch-node Edge Function  → OpenRouter text-embedding-3-small
> 132	  ↓
> 133	pgvector HNSW index (cosine similarity, 768 dims)  ← truncated output, schema is vector(768)
> 134	  ↓
> 135	stability_score + FSRS-6 decay (migration 20260425190000)
> 136	```

> 138	- System nodes: `user_id IS NULL` — visible to all tenants

> 158	### 3D Constellation View (`/dashboard/constellation`)
> 159	
> 160	```
> 161	CrewGraph.tsx          ← R3F Scene root; SQUAD_META hoisted to module scope (never inline)
> 162	  ├── AgentNode.tsx    ← per-agent 3D mesh
> 163	  ├── AgentEdge.tsx    ← particle edges; uses key={particleCount} to force remount on resize
> 164	  └── SquadHull.tsx    ← translucent hull; selector uses useShallow to avoid re-render on unrelated updates
> 165	
> 166	useCrewData.ts         ← TanStack Query for agents + edges; sets loaded via isSuccess/isError flags
> 167	useSimulation.ts       ← drives agent positions; uses getState() inside interval (zero deps) — never put
> 168	                          agents/edges in useEffect deps or React 18 concurrent mode will cascade re-renders
> 169	```
> 170	
> 171	**React 18 / Zustand pitfall** (Error #185): subscribing to `agents`/`edges` arrays in `useEffect` deps creates new array refs on every `updateAgentStatus` call → interval teardown loop → Maximum Update Depth. Use `getState()` inside the callback instead.
