> 257	### Edge Functions (`supabase/functions/`)
> 258	All sensitive operations (AI generation, social publishing, Stripe, self-heal) run in Deno Edge Functions — never expose API secrets to the client. Every user-facing function requires a valid JWT; cron/service-role functions use the service role key.
> 259	
> 260	**Nuclear functions (must always be deployed):**
> 261	- `embed-mcorch-node` — neural embedding for every node insert
> 262	- `orchestrate-content` — full campaign pipeline (10 mcoCoins, step 6 = knowledge node)
> 263	- `get-infra-status` — reads `infra_health_logs` for Neural HUD
> 264	- `rescue-video` — recovers Veo video generation operations that timed out or were interrupted
> 265	
> 266	### Video Rescue Protocol
> 267	
> 268	When a video generation operation (Google Veo via `generate-image`) fails mid-flight or the client disconnects, the `operation_id` is preserved in `content_library`. Recovery flow:
> 269	
> 270	```
> 271	POST /functions/v1/rescue-video
> 272	  { "content_id": "<uuid>", "operation_id": "<operation_name>" }
> 273	  Authorization: Bearer <user_jwt>
> 274	
> 275	→ Polls Google Generative Language API for the operation result
> 276	→ Downloads video bytes (validates ≥ 100 KB — rejects JSON error stubs)
> 277	→ Uploads to Supabase Storage bucket `generated-videos` (private)
> 278	→ Updates content_library.video_url with a public URL
> 279	→ Returns { status: "ok", video_url }
> 280	```
> 281	
> 282	Local companion: `rescue.ts` (run via `bun run rescue.ts <operation_id> <content_id>`).
> 283	
> 284	### Security model
> 285	- RLS enabled on every table; default deny.
> 286	- Column-level restrictions on `access_token`, `refresh_token`, and Stripe fields.
> 287	- RESTRICTIVE policies on financial/affiliate tables (clients cannot delete).
> 288	- Storage buckets are private; files are served via short-lived signed URLs.
> 289	- Admin checks use the `has_role()` SECURITY DEFINER function to avoid recursive RLS.
> 290	- Multi-tenant: `mcorch_nodes` and `mcorch_edges` use `user_id + project_id` isolation (migration `20260425210000`).
> 291	
> 292	### API Tenancy Model — Per-User Credentials (Sovereign Directive 2026-05-19)
> 293	
> 294	**UNBREAKABLE RULE:** Toda integração com API externa (provedores de IA, redes sociais, afiliados, gateways de pagamento, etc.) MUST resolver credenciais por usuário, escopadas via `auth.uid()`. Variável de ambiente global é fallback restrito (service-role/cron/onboarding default), nunca o caminho primário em fluxo user-facing.
> 295	
> 296	**Resolution order (mandatory):**
> 297	
> 298	1. **Per-user table** — ler de `user_api_keys` ou `<service>_config` filtrando por `user_id = auth.uid()` e flag `is_active = true` quando aplicável.
> 299	2. **Global vault fallback** — `Deno.env.get('<SERVICE>_API_KEY')` SÓ permitido em:
> 300	   - Cron jobs / system service-role flows (sem `auth.uid()` disponível).
> 301	   - Sovereign-only test paths ou onboarding default explícito (free tier compartilhado, documentado).
> 302	   - Edge functions invocadas por trigger (pg_net, webhooks externos) onde JWT do user não está no path.
> 303	3. **Hard failure** — se nem (1) nem (2) resolvem, retornar HTTP 402/501 estruturado: `{ error: "<service>_not_configured", action: "Configure your <service> credentials at /dashboard/<service>" }`. NÃO seguir com um shared/default key silenciosamente.
> 304	
> 305	**Tabelas canônicas existentes:**
> 306	
> 307	| Service domain | Table | Lookup column |
> 308	|----------------|-------|---------------|
> 309	| AI providers (Groq, OpenRouter, Gemini/Google, Replicate, OpenAI) | `user_api_keys` | `groq_api_key`, `openrouter_api_key`, `google_api_key` (Gemini — **não** `gemini_api_key`, que não existe), `replicate_api_key`, `openai_api_key` |
> 310	| ML affiliate program | `affiliate_config` | `app_id`, `client_secret`, `redirect_uri` (UNIQUE per `user_id + platform`) |
> 311	| Social OAuth (LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram) | `social_credentials` | `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `expires_at` |
> 312	| Higgsfield (vídeo) | `user_api_keys.higgsfield_api_key` | (single key) |
> 313	| Stripe | service-side only (admin escopo Stripe) | `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` env (system-level) |
> 314	
> 315	**Adding a new external API integration requires (ordered):**
> 316	
> 317	1. Coluna em `user_api_keys` OU tabela dedicada `<service>_config` com RLS `auth.uid() = user_id` + UNIQUE constraint.
> 318	2. UI no `/dashboard/settings` (ou page dedicada como `/dashboard/affiliates`) com hook TanStack Query padrão (`useUserApiKeys` / `use<Service>Config`).
> 319	3. Lookup helper em `src/lib/<service>.ts` OU diretamente no edge function (padrão `process-affiliate-link:176-187`).
> 320	4. Telemetry em `infra_health_logs` com `service='<integration-name>'` em cada path (success + degraded + error).
> 321	5. SOP em `docs/processes/<integration>-credential-resolution.md` antes de qualquer código (Lei 2 Survival).
> 322	
> 323	**Anti-patterns proibidos:**
> 324	
> 325	- ❌ `Deno.env.get('<SERVICE>_API_KEY')` em fluxos user-facing sem fallback per-user implementado.
> 326	- ❌ Misturar per-user (POST) com global (GET/cron) no mesmo serviço sem OTD registrada com SLA explícito.
> 327	- ❌ Adicionar nova integração sem ao menos coluna/tabela + UI + lookup helper.
> 328	- ❌ Hardcodar `<service>_id`/`<service>_token` em scripts cron sem JOIN com tabela per-user.
> 329	- ❌ Compartilhar revenue/quota de um user com outro via shared API key (fraude por design).
> 330	
> 331	**Why this exists:** Phase Commercial multi-tenant readiness exige (a) revenue attribution correto por tenant; (b) segregação de quota/rate limit per user (não um user esgotar limite global); (c) risco financeiro isolado (credencial roubada de um tenant não vaza para outros); (d) compliance LGPD (cada user controla suas credenciais e pode revogá-las).
> 332	
> 333	**Existing OTDs flagging violations:**
> 334	
> 335	- ~~**OTD-OE661-PER-USER** (RPN 120 · SLA 2026-06-02)~~ ✅ **FECHADA 2026-05-30** (commits `22bfa98` refactor per-user fail-closed + SOP Lei 2, `eebea0a` real ML links + per-user `affiliate_tag`; migration `20260530183000_affiliate_tag_per_user.sql`). `scripts/link-forge.ts` resolve `affiliate_config.affiliate_tag` por `user_id` (skip + observation node quando falta — zero refs ao token global); `process-affiliate-link` GET+POST resolve `affiliate_config.app_id` per-user **fail-closed** (Gate G6 — as 2 menções a `GCRUX_ML_AFFILIATE_TOKEN`/`ML_AFFILIATE_ID` no arquivo são apenas comentários documentando a ausência do fallback global). Prova material em produção 2026-05-31: GET de asset sem config → `HTTP 302 Location: /dashboard/settings?no_config=1` (não vaza token global). SOP: `docs/processes/affiliate-credential-resolution.md`.

> 351	## Code standards
> 352	
> 353	- **Language split:** All code, variables, comments, and logs → **English**. All UI text, validation messages, and toasts → **Portuguese (Brazil)**.
> 354	- TypeScript strict mode; explicit types on all props, API responses, and payloads.
> 355	- Naming: `PascalCase` for components/interfaces, `camelCase` for functions/variables, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` for constants/env vars.
> 356	- Commit convention: `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `chore:` prefixes.
> 357	- **Every new migration MUST pass `/security-review` before commit. No exceptions.** (FMEA-011 — cross-tenant data leak risk)
> 358	- **Every new external API integration MUST follow API Tenancy Model — Per-User Credentials** (see Architecture section). No global `Deno.env.get('<SERVICE>_API_KEY')` em fluxos user-facing sem fallback per-user implementado.
> 359

> 365	- `VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID`

> 367	Edge Function secrets (configured in Lovable Cloud vault, not in `.env`): `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `TWITTER_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`, `LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`, `LOVABLE_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
